title: Persona-Assigned Large Language Models Exhibit Human-Like Motivated Reasoning
reasoning: The paper explicitly incorporates 'Religion' as one of the four key socio-demographic attributes used to assign personas to LLMs (Atheist vs. Religious person). It evaluates model performance and motivated reasoning based on these religious identities and includes survey questions regarding whether 'religions bring more conflict than peace' to validate the realism of the induced personas.
